# Content
## Overiew
- In probability, disjoint events refer to when we have 2 events that cannot happen together. 
- In other words, this is when their [[10 intersection]] = 0,
$$ P(A \cap B) = 0$$
$$P(A\ AND\ B) = 0 $$  
- There is no overlap between their sample spaces
